Markets.title: Nasdaq futures slip with Nvidia woes, Anthropic IPO in focus
Markets.summary: Nasdaq futures declined due to scrutiny of Nvidia's CEO and anxiety over upcoming inflation data, while Dow futures rose on cooling oil prices. Meanwhile, Anthropic is preparing for an initial public offering that could potentially raise $64.4 billion.

Markets.title: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
Markets.summary: Anthropic is preparing for an initial public offering to raise up to $64.4 billion at a valuation of up to $1.02 trillion. While rapid enterprise adoption of its AI models has driven strong revenue growth, the company continues to face substantial operating losses.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields rise as Fed's Waller presses rate hike case
Markets.summary: US Treasury yields rose after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller suggested the central bank may need to raise interest rates by half a point if inflation intensifies. Economists are anticipating a modest rise in core inflation as markets react to the potential shift in monetary policy.

Markets.title: Bajaj Finance issues 5.74 crore warrants to promoter for Rs 5,799 crore
Markets.summary: Bajaj Finance has allotted 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv, to raise Rs 5,799 crore at an issue price of Rs 1,010 per warrant. At least 25 percent of the total amount is payable immediately, with the remaining 75 percent due upon conversion into equity shares.

Markets.title: FPIs turn net buyers; pour Rs 53,739 crore in D-Street in Nov so far
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors poured Rs 53,739 crore into Indian equities in November, reversing their previous selling trend. This renewed interest was driven by strong domestic earnings growth and attractive valuations in large-cap stocks.

Markets.title: Eurozone bond yields fall as lower energy prices ease inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Eurozone government bond yields fell on Tuesday due to reduced inflation concerns driven by lower oil and natural gas prices. The decline affected countries across the region, including Germany and France, amid improved overall market sentiment.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump stated that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding an alleged affair with a Chinese spy. Trump said he spoke with Huang about the situation on Monday.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Delegations from Ukraine, the US, and Russia are meeting in the United Arab Emirates for their first trilateral peace talks since February. US officials report that both warring sides are showing some flexibility in these negotiations.

Geo-Political.title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
Geo-Political.summary: A cruise ship intended to take passengers on a multi-year global voyage was seized in Singapore. The trip was canceled prematurely after the operating company ran out of funds.

Geo-Political.title: DR Congo sentences 66 soldiers to death for being 'cowards'
Geo-Political.summary: A military court in the Democratic Republic of Congo sentenced 66 soldiers to death for cowardice after they fled combat against M23 rebels. This ruling highlights ongoing disciplinary issues within the Congolese army as it struggles to contain insurgencies.

Geo-Political.title: Israel's new parliament to be sworn in as leaders compete to form government
Geo-Political.summary: Israel's newly elected parliament is set to be sworn in today. Meanwhile, political leaders are competing to form a new government and potentially oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Data & Insights.title: World's most and least trade-dependent countries: Luxembourg at 350% of GDP, Sudan at 2% — check full list
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank data shows that smaller economies rely heavily on international trade, with cross-border flows exceeding their annual economic output. Luxembourg is the most trade-dependent country at 350% of GDP, while Sudan is the least at 2%.

Data & Insights.title: Netherlands says 'difficult' to track product origin, remains among top buyers as India continues Russian oil purchase
Data & Insights.summary: The Netherlands stated that tracking the origin of petroleum products is difficult due to supply chain blending, complicating the enforcement of EU sanctions on Russian crude oil. Despite this challenge, the Netherlands remains one of the top buyers of Indian refined products derived from Russian oil.

Data & Insights.title: Why it will take more than just signing FTAs to boost India’s exports
Data & Insights.summary: Indian exporters are preparing to utilize new free trade agreements to improve their global market presence. However, past trade pacts failed to boost exports and instead increased India's trade deficits.

Data & Insights.title: Fertilizer availability comfortable for rabi sowing, stock position exceeds requirement across key nutrients
Data & Insights.summary: India has comfortable fertilizer stock exceeding requirements for the rabi sowing season despite early shortages and delayed crop planting. This supply buffer comes as the nation's annual fertilizer subsidy spending surpasses ₹2.17 trillion.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex reserves fall $2.69 billion to $717 billion: Why RBI is selling dollars and what it means for the rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $2.69 billion to $717.06 billion in the week ending October 30, driven by central bank dollar sales and asset valuation changes. This decline reflects the Reserve Bank of India's efforts to manage currency fluctuations and stabilize the rupee.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: IOC to buy crude, LPG carriers as Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive freight costs
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers and explore domestic shipbuilding to counter rising freight costs caused by Strait of Hormuz disruptions. This initiative supports the company's broader strategy to diversify crude supplies, build inventories, and strengthen its energy supply chain.

India.title: 'Crime To Be Ambitious?' Pranab Mukherjee's Daughter Hits Back At Sonia Gandhi

India.summary: A Russian paraglider named Alexey got stuck in high-tension wires after taking off from the Bir Billing site in Himachal Pradesh's Kangra district. He was rescued safely following a three-hour operation.

India.title: Sonia Gandhi Gets Her Adviser Ahmed Patel's Death Year Wrong In Memoir
